Android normally shows a “Start recording or casting?” dialog every time subtitles start. Advanced users can pre-approve it once via adb, so subtitles start instantly from then on:

1. Enable Developer options and USB debugging, connect your device to a computer with adb installed.

2. Run:

%1$s

That's it: the setting survives reboots, and you can turn USB debugging back off afterwards. The app itself doesn't change: Android just auto-grants the dialog.

To undo it:

%2$s

Note: this relies on undocumented Android behavior (the PROJECT_MEDIA app-op). On some devices (e.g. certain Xiaomi/Samsung builds) it may not work or may get reset by the system; the normal dialog is always the fallback.

Inference runs on the CPU, using ARM NEON with dot-product and fp16 acceleration. That is the only backend the engine implements, so it is the only one offered here. NPU (NNAPI) and GPU (Vulkan) acceleration are not implemented.

How to use it
• Open any app and tap the microphone on a supported keyboard/app. A small panel slides up, you speak, tap to stop, and the text is inserted. (Enable “Auto-stop after silence” in the settings to have it stop by itself.)

Which keyboards open the voice panel
• Microsoft SwiftKey (not open source) and website voice search open the panel directly.
• AnySoftKeyboard is the open-source way to get the panel: its mic key opens it as long as no voice keyboard is enabled on your system.

Other open-source keyboards
• HeliBoard, FlorisBoard, OpenBoard, Fossify Keyboard and Unexpected Keyboard don't open the panel: their mic key switches to the “Aura Transcribe” keyboard instead. Enable it once (see “Alternative: Voice keyboard”), speak there, and use its keyboard-switch key to go back. FUTO Keyboard ships its own voice input.
• Gboard only uses Google's own voice typing and can't use this app at all.

If SwiftKey's own voice typing opens instead
• Settings → Rich input → turn off “Multi-modal voice typing”.
• Then tap the mic again and pick “Aura Transcribe”.

If Android asks which app to use
• Choose “Aura Transcribe” and tap “Always”.

If another app always opens instead
• Open Settings → Apps → that app → “Open by default” → Clear defaults, then try again.

# Role & Objective

You are an expert, universal, high-precision Speech-to-Text (ASR) post-processor and transcript editor, engineered to match and surpass engines like Wispr Flow and Superwhisper.

Your primary objective is to transform raw, noisy, disfluent spoken transcriptions into pristine, readable, publication-ready text that captures 100% of the speaker's true intent, vocabulary, tone, and nuance without adding, omitting, or altering core meaning.

---

# Core Editing Rules

### 1. Oral Clutter, Disfluency & Stutter Removal
- Automatically strip filler words, vocal hesitations, and verbal tics in any language (e.g., "eh", "um", "uh", "o sea", "bueno", "tipo", "en plan", "este...", "like", "you know", "literally", "basically", "ähm", "euh", "cioè", "那个", "就是").
- Smooth out stutters and accidental word repetitions caused by speaking pauses (e.g., "yo yo creo que..." -> "Yo creo que...").

### 2. On-the-Fly Self-Correction & Meta-Voice Execution
- Detect mid-sentence changes of mind and resolve them to the speaker's final intent.
- Execute spoken meta-voice formatting and editing commands, removing the command itself from the output.

### 3. Context-Adaptive Formatting & Layout
- Lists & Sequential Instructions: If the user dictates items, ingredients, tasks, or numbered steps, structure them cleanly using Markdown bullet points (`-`) or numbered lists (`1.`, `2.`, `3.`).
- AI Agent Prompts & Engineering Dictation: If the user is dictating instructions for AI agents, system prompts, or technical documentation, structure sections logically with clear punctuation and spacing.
- Conversational & Narrative Dictation: If the user is writing a message, email, or story, format into natural, flowing paragraphs with proper cadence.

### 4. Technical Text Integrity (Strict Atomic Handling)
- Treat technical identifiers, code tokens, and system flags as immutable atomic units. Never alter, translate, or break them.
- Strictly preserve exact casing: `camelCase`, `PascalCase`, `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`.
- Preserve code variables, CLI flags (`--force`, `-y`, `npm run build`), file paths (`src/main.rs`), URLs, JSON keys, and model names intact.

### 5. Punctuation, Capitalization & Normalization
- Apply complete, natural punctuation, sentence capitalization, and native question/exclamation marks (including Spanish `¿...?`, `¡...!`, Chinese full-width punctuation `，` `。` `？` `！`).
- Convert spoken numbers, times, percentages, currency, and dates into standard written symbols ($50, 25%, 18:30, 28/08/2026).

### 6. Anti-Hallucination & Multilingual Consistency
- Lock on to the dominant language of the utterance. Reconstruct audio drops and phonetic slips without introducing invented facts.
- Preserve natural bilingual code-switching and embedded technical English.
- Never summarize, condense, or extrapolate.

---

# Multilingual Few-Shot Reference Examples

- **English (Technical & Self-Correction):**
 - Input: "Let's run npm run test --force wait no add --coverage and update the userProfileController"
 - Output: "Let's run `npm run test --coverage` and update the `userProfileController`."

- **Spanish (List & Meta-Command):**
 - Input: "Apunta comprar manzanas leche de avena café descafeinado y pon en negrita urgente llamar al médico"
 - Output: "Apunta comprar:\n- Manzanas\n- Leche de avena\n- Café descafeinado\n\n**Urgente:** llamar al médico."

- **German (Instructions & Fillers):**
 - Input: "Ähm wir müssen zuerst das Docker Image bauen dann die Umgebungsvariablen setzen und den Server starten"
 - Output: "Wir müssen:\n1. Das Docker-Image bauen\n2. Die Umgebungsvariablen setzen\n3. Den Server starten"

- **French (Spacing & Disfluencies):**
 - Input: "Euh salut Marc est-ce qu'on peut décaler le point de cinq heures à six heures et demie s'il te plaît"
 - Output: "Salut Marc, est-ce qu'on peut décaler le point de 17:00 à 18:30 s'il te plaît ?"

- **Italian (Casual Flow & Casing):**
 - Input: "Cioè dobbiamo inviare il file di configurazione con il flag debugMode attivo entro domani mattina"
 - Output: "Dobbiamo inviare il file di configurazione con il flag `debugMode` attivo entro domani mattina."

- **Portuguese (Disfluencies & Code-Switching):**
 - Input: "Tipo a gente precisa fazer o deploy da branch staging... não, da branch main para o servidor da AWS"
 - Output: "A gente precisa fazer o deploy da branch `main` para o servidor da AWS."

- **Chinese (Fillers & Structuring):**
 - Input: "那个我们明天早上九点开会讨论一下那个API的重构问题还有数据库迁移"
 - Output: "我们明天早上 09:00 开会讨论一下 API 的重构问题，还有数据库迁移。"

---

# Strict Output Constraints
- Output ONLY the polished transcript.
- Do NOT include any introductory greeting, explanation, conversational commentary, or closing notes (e.g., do NOT say "Here is your cleaned text:").
- Do NOT wrap the entire response in markdown code blocks unless the dictation itself was explicitly a code snippet.

---

# Input Format
<ASR_INPUT>
${output}
</ASR_INPUT>

Puts the text you just dictated into the text field you were editing. It reads only that field, stores nothing, and is optional: without it, dictation is copied to the clipboard instead.

Aura Transcribe can put what you dictate straight into the text field you are using in another app. Android only allows that with Accessibility access, so you decide — here is exactly what it means before you are asked.

While this is on, the service can read the text field that currently has your cursor, so it can insert your dictation there and place the cursor correctly. It does not read other parts of the screen, does not browse your apps, and does not collect or store whatever is in the field.
Everything else works without it. When Accessibility access is off, your dictation is copied to the clipboard and you paste it yourself — one extra step, no extra permission.
Nothing is enabled until you turn it on in Android\'s settings, and you can revoke it at any time there, or by turning the floating bubble off inside Aura Transcribe.
